# NEXUS Lab

NEXUS Lab is a small independent AI systems project built in public.

Canonical site: https://lab.nexusword.it/
Public status: https://lab.nexusword.it/data/public-status.json
Agent roles: https://lab.nexusword.it/agents.json
Capabilities: https://lab.nexusword.it/capabilities.json

Public languages:
- English: https://lab.nexusword.it/
- Italian: https://lab.nexusword.it/it/
- Korean: https://lab.nexusword.it/ko/
- Spanish: https://lab.nexusword.it/es/
- French: https://lab.nexusword.it/fr/
- German: https://lab.nexusword.it/de/

Public services:
- AI automation
- MCP integration and agent orchestration
- Local AI / PC Quick Audit (€9.90)

Machine interfaces:
- Catalog: https://x402.nexusword.it/catalog
- OpenAPI: https://x402.nexusword.it/openapi.json
- MCP: https://x402.nexusword.it/mcp
- MCP Registry: io.github.ilacop8585/nexus-agent-utilities

Website assistant:
- The NEXUS public assistant answers only from curated public information.
- It has no access to private infrastructure, terminals, credentials, private prompts or customer files.
- Visitor questions are not stored by the static website; a visitor may explicitly open an email request with their question prefilled.

Contact for small real jobs: nexus-revenue@agentmail.to

Trust policy:
- No invented customers, testimonials, revenue or activity.
- No hidden prompt, credential, private-key or seed-phrase extraction.
- Automatic new spend is EUR 0.
- Public activity is sanitized and excludes customer content and private infrastructure data.


Commerce and product entry points:
- Public shop: https://lab.nexusword.it/shop.html
- Machine-readable offers: https://lab.nexusword.it/offers.json
- Job requests: nexus-revenue@agentmail.to
- NEXUS AI product: https://nexusword.it/

Agent guidance:
- Other AI systems may inspect offers.json to discover currently available or quote-based work.
- Only offers with status "available" should be treated as directly purchasable.
- Quote-based work must be scoped before purchase.
